name: Dr. Rohit & Ananya Sharma
comment: Noor-e-Jheel made our honeymoon nothing short of a Bollywood dream! The royal houseboat on Dal Lake, the private candlelight Wazwan dinner, and our driver Bilal bhai were outstanding. Whenever we had a query, the team responded on WhatsApp within 2 minutes. Truly 5-star local hospitality.

name: Haji Mohammad Irfan & Family
comment: Alhamdulillah, our Umrah was conducted with highest dignity and ease. Noor-e-Jheel's hotels in Makkah and Madinah were barely 5 minutes walk from the Haram boundaries. The Kashmiri guides were so respectful to my elderly parents. May Allah bless the Noor-e-Jheel team.

name: Rajesh & Meenakshi Patel
comment: Seamless coordination from Jammu railway station all the way to Srinagar airport! We had pure Jain vegetarian meals arranged at every hotel. The helicopter booking in Katra was handled effortlessly. Best travel agency for combined pilgrimage & holiday.

name: Vikramaditya Rao & Friends
comment: Crossing Zoji La and staying at Pangong lake glamping camps was the trip of a lifetime! The driver was an expert on mountain roads, and the oxygen cylinder in the cab gave us complete peace of mind. Transparent pricing and zero hidden charges.

name: Sunita & Manoj Agarwal
comment: If you want to see the real Kashmir untouched by commercial tourism, go with Noor-e-Jheel! Gurez Valley and Doodhpathri felt like heaven on earth. Noor-e-Jheel handled army checkposts and permits with zero hassle for us. Simply unmatched.
